rules.title: San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance (affordable housing)
rules.requirement: San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions. The passage gives no detail on the specific limits, timing rules or covered housing.

coverage.summary: Applies to affordable housing decisions involving applicants with arrest or conviction history.
coverage.other_conditions: Limited to affordable housing, per the HRC page.

rules.quoted_span: San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions.
rules.review_note: The passage is only a summary on an HRC web page. The code section, effective date and specific restrictions are not stated.
rules.source_notes: The HRC page is an official city source, but it describes the ordinance only in one line.

rules.title: City-linked affordable housing tenant selection policy: credit screening limits (Feb. 2017)
rules.requirement: Under this policy, the agent agrees not to use an applicant's credit score to approve or deny housing applications. Credit history may be considered only in lieu of rental history when rental history is unavailable. A lack of credit history is not sufficient justification to reject an applicant.
rules.key_value: No use of credit score to approve or deny; credit history only in lieu of rental history

coverage.summary: Applies to agents or property managers under the policy. The passages do not name the covered housing.

rules.effective_date_note: The document is dated February 2017. Its effective date is not stated.
rules.quoted_span: The agent agrees not to use the applicant credit score to approve or deny housing
rules.review_note: This is a policy document, not an ordinance. The issuing body and the scope of the housing it covers are not identified in the passages, so it may not be a general law.
rules.source_notes: The source type is 'official city-linked policy'. The document also covers criminal-history mitigating factors.
